Name: Custom Inventory Sprite
Author: JER3M7
Description:
This mod was created with the idea that I wanted to show the faces of my drawn characters on the inventory page. 


You can find guideline images to help you draw your custom images in the “assets” folder inside the mod file.


The image is made up of 4 frames, and you can draw whatever you want within the guidelines - it's that simple!

[b]!! only one image, custom_sprite_sheet.png, is applied to the actual game. !![/b]


But be warned, if you use this mod, you won't be able to see your character's outfit directly from the inventory menu!


Feel free to modify this mod for your own personal use, but please don't upload it anywhere else!


I'm always using a translator, and I'm really sorry if my language sounds weird. Hopefully my words came across well.

Thank you!

Downloads.Description: Fixed images appearing in a different compartment than the belongings compartment
